scope: Prescribed unit-norm activities, independent trials, no optimizer, no neural feedback, no Sudoku. Not a Hopfield capacity measurement.
association_protocol: Current target v0 at q=k0; historical unit keys/values accumulated as outer products. Exact equivalent to isolated lambda=.1 STDP key-then-value episodes with trace reset and q/.9. G-only retrieves only the latest association by design.

continuous_STDP_cycle.note: Same prescribed final cycle and fixed query; no target declares the persistent mean useful or harmful.

limits: G-only latest-association target is defined to match its current write; this does not establish superiority for a task requiring older associations.
Isolated timed-pair load sweep resets eligibility between associations; continuous-cycle experiment does not reset eligibility.
Rank and read interference do not establish an attractor capacity threshold.
No neural feedback or learned projections; not a diagnosis of the original training reversal.
